trigger: strict fully nested support-width selection failed within the single global nearest-prototype envelope (run 31946240154)
cohort: same 16 inspected Izu vascular-plant taxa; development-only

retained_layers.domain: terrestrial Izu development frame; new training-only domain gate is not tuned in this experiment
retained_layers.feature_scaling: training median and IQR, unchanged from current NDVI support
retained_layers.set_selector: greedy maximum newly covered public land-grid cells
retained_layers.inner_selection: strict paired complete-fold lift versus q=1; no positive lift falls back to q=1; exact positive ties prefer broader q

multimodal_representation.mode_inference: minimum spanning tree in globally robust-scaled training NDVI-state space; cut edges above the historical robust gap threshold
multimodal_representation.gap_rule_source: historical ACSP occupancy-geometry implementation, stabilized in commit d50164bb795bd4f2bf1c7af529b7812a5dc45332; not tuned on the present outer outcomes
multimodal_representation.mode_weighting: equal mode opportunity after 500 m spatial thinning
multimodal_representation.support_size_control: for every q<1, the multimodal eligibility mask must contain exactly the same number of public-grid cells as the corresponding current single-envelope q mask
multimodal_representation.construction: rank grid cells by nearest environmental distance separately for each inferred mode and add the nearest still-unselected cell from each mode in deterministic round-robin order until the single-envelope target cell count is reached
multimodal_representation.single_mode_identity: if training data contain one inferred mode, multimodal support is exactly the existing single-envelope support mask

controls.single_envelope_fixed_q10: existing NDVI nearest-prototype q=0.10 support + identical max-coverage selector
controls.multimodal_fixed_q10: new representation at q=0.10 + identical max-coverage selector

primary_question: does fully nested training-selected multimodal support recover stable low-budget ecological value over global maximum coverage without hard-coding q=0.10?
secondary_questions: does multimodal fixed q10 improve on the existing single-envelope fixed q10?
are gains concentrated in training folds with more than one inferred environmental mode?
hard_boundaries: No new environmental variable is introduced.
No q, K, radius, gap multiplier, or mode weight is tuned on outer-held-out outcomes.
Outer-held-out coordinates remain invisible until support representation, q, and selected sets are frozen.
Campanula field coordinates are not used.
Frozen 192 Practical Core taxa remain untouched.
If multimodal support fails, retain the failure and move next to support scale, not back to weight tuning.
